# Portavita Devblog

> > Technical blog by Portavita covering database performance benchmarking (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, InfluxDB), Apache Kafka optimization, and software engineering best practices.

Portavita's developer blog features in-depth technical articles on database tuning, message queue optimization, and OWASP security compliance. The blog also provides career advice for developers preparing technical portfolios for job applications.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL performance tuning
- Apache Kafka compression & optimization
- Database benchmarking (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, InfluxDB)
- Timeseries data storage
- WAL compression
- effective_io_concurrency
- JSON storage comparison
- OWASP Dependency-Check
- IEC 62304 compliance (SOUP management)
- GitHub/GitLab portfolio preparation
- Kafka consumer offset management
- At-least-once delivery patterns
- SSD vs HDD performance
- pgbench benchmarking
- Grafana integration

## Database Performance & Optimization

- [A JSON use case comparison between PostgreSQL and MongoDB](https://portavita.github.io/2018-10-31-blog_A_JSON_use_case_comparison_between_PostgreSQL_and_MongoDB): Performance benchmark comparing PostgreSQL vs MongoDB for JSON storage
- [A Timeseries Case Study: InfluxDB VS PostgreSQL to store data](https://portavita.github.io/2018-07-31-blog_influxdb_vs_postgresql): InfluxDB vs PostgreSQL timeseries performance comparison for Grafana
- [About wal_compression on PostgreSQL](https://portavita.github.io/2019-05-13-blog_about_wal_compression): PostgreSQL WAL compression benchmarking with pgbench on SSD vs HDD
- [PostgreSQL: effective_io_concurrency benchmarked](https://portavita.github.io/2019-07-19-PostgreSQL_effective_io_concurrency_benchmarked): PostgreSQL effective_io_concurrency tuning for SSD & RAID configurations

## Apache Kafka Best Practices

- [Why Kafka compression might save you thousands of dollars](https://portavita.github.io/2021-01-25-Why_Kafka_compression_might_save_you_thousands_of_dollars): Kafka compression cost optimization with gzip, snappy, lz4 & zstd benchmarks
- [Caveats for Working with Kafka Consumers](https://portavita.github.io/2016-06-23-kafka-consumer-caveats): Apache Kafka consumer offset management & at-least-once delivery patterns

## Software Engineering & Career Development

- [Preparing Your Online Code Repositories for Job Applications](https://portavita.github.io/2021-12-17-preparing-your-online-repositories-for-job-applications): GitHub/GitLab portfolio tips for technical recruiting at Portavita
- [OWASP Dependency Checks and Management of Software of Unknown Provenance](https://portavita.github.io/2019-09-19-owasp-soup-management): OWASP dependency scanning & SOUP management for IEC 62304 compliance
